Rick Milliard is an UFS Assassin and one of the first, main chapter, captures in Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena. She is now loyal to Fuuma Kotaro.



Personality
She has a smug tone and can be rude, having no issue to kill. Sadistically, she feels thrill and joy while hunting and killing. She enjoys putting people against the wall and create fear.

Rick is in tune with her animalistic instinct, but should her instinct to kill be blocked, she goes into intense heat. As her beast instincts normally suppress her intense sexual urges, she became loyal to Fuuma Kotarou after he sealed her powers to break her mind.

Appearance
She is a rather small girl with smaller physique, with very short dark pink hair and amber eyes. Always armed, she wears a rather oversized coat, military boots, a very small green top and very short black shorts.

History
Background
A young assassin, which was hired in secret by the UFS.

She was educated by her parents to be a skilled fighter, after being hired she often fights with other soldiers on the front. Rick normally fights against people, but at times is used against weak demons.

Timeline TABA
She was originally set to lead an underwater raid on Kotarou's base by orders of her superiors in the UFS. However, she was attacked by Kotarou and Tokiko when they pre-emptively struck first to prevent the raid. After her power was sealed, she went into heat, Kotaro broke her and joined his group, helping them in later missions.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Guns and Knifes

Beast Mode: Enhanced animalistic instincts, giving her better knowledge of her surroundings. Making her very violent and brutal in combat.
Physical Prowess: High speed and physical ability
Media
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena
Taimanin RPGX (Recollection Gallery)
Trivia
Her beast mode abilities are similar to Taimanin abilities that other characters have, that have similar beast or animal characteristics.
It is unknown what is the origin of her ability. Either she's a former Taimanin, which is very unlikely, or she was given the ability by the use of UFS Hell Technology.
